summary_1line: Debate arises over Draupadi marrying all five Pandava brothers; Yudhishthira defends it while Drupada and others question its morality until Vyasa arrives.

image_candidates.scene_text: In Drupada’s royal hall, Yudhishthira calmly declares that Draupadi will become the wife of all five Pandava brothers before a stunned court.
The sage Vyasa enters the सभा, and the assembled kings and Pandavas rise together in reverence as he takes a golden-carpeted seat.
Drupada and Dhrishtadyumna stand troubled before the Pandavas, debating the morality of one woman marrying five brothers.
